description: Create an Airflow DAG factory for saas_metrics that generates one ingestion DAG per source system from a YAML config file. Each config entry provides: name, schedule, connection id, list of tables, and owner. The factory must: (1) load the YAML once per parse, (2) create a DAG per entry with a unique dag_id 'ingest_<name>', (3) create extract and load tasks per table inside a TaskGroup, (4) register every DAG in globals(), (5) fail parsing loudly on duplicate names or invalid cron strings. Generated DAGs must have catchup=False and static start dates.
edge_cases: Closures in a loop: callables must bind the table and connection via default arguments or op_kwargs, not capture the loop variable
Removing a source from the YAML makes its DAG disappear from the UI while history remains; this should be documented, not hidden by a try/except
start_date must not be datetime.now() or days_ago-based dynamic values
No database or network calls at parse time; only reading the local YAML file
Table names containing dots or dashes must be sanitized into valid task ids
common_failure_modes: FM6: Late-binding closure makes every generated task extract the last table in the config
FM6: DAG objects created in a function but never placed in globals() are not discovered by the scheduler
FM6: Dynamic start_date causes runs to never be scheduled
